# `accounts.current_account.AccountMarkedDormant`

The account is marked dormant after an inactivity horizon ([ADR-PC-037](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-037-current-account-family.md): Active -> Dormant). Dormant is a NON-terminal, reversible state — an inactive account reactivates on use (accounts.current_account.AccountReactivated), distinguishing the demand account from the loan's good-or-closed binary. The dormancy CRITERIA (the inactivity horizon) are pack/product policy, not on this event. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | AccountId (Guid) — the account stream id / opaque account_ref. Never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `marked_on` | `int` (`date`) | MarkedOn (DateOnly) — the value-date dormancy took effect, as days since epoch. An input date, never a clock read. |
| `reason` | `string` | The structural dormancy reason code (e.g. INACTIVITY_HORIZON) — a stable machine code, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
